text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪ Reward pudding, reward 
pudding~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, EH!? It's not here!?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You're so silly. You were eating it 
yourself yesterday, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“...... Hey, Heart-chan? Wanna go on a 
convenience store date with me right now—”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Wipe the dirt off your own tail, 
will you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ Heart-chan is such a dummy carrot... 
Fine then, I'll just invite someone 
else...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait... Ah! Pokke-senpai, perfect timing~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Want to walk over to the convenience store 
with me right now? There's something I 
need to buy—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Pass. I'm headed over to 
Fuji-san's place right now. Catch ya 
later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! Jeez! At least pretend to think 
about it for a second~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ai-chan's here! Hey~ wanna go on a 
convenience store date with me right now? 
♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No... I'm sorry. I'm heading back to 
the Miho dorms for a bath now.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! It's on the way home, so what's the 
harm! Let's go buy some convenience store 
sweets~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That's no good. It's always best to take 
care of body maintenance as early as 
possible."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Besides... eating sweets at this hour in 
the first place really isn't good for—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Ah, ah, I gotta go! Well then, enjoy 
your bath~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. The truth is, I made plans with 
Cesario-senpai after this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm zorryyyyyyy! I'm on episode 24 of 
PreFie and my face is totally flooded~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Nobody's following me~! If I don't 
find them soon, I'm gonna miss curfew!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ――You haven't left yet?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! Pocket-senpai! Wait, are you 
already done with your errands!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well... I mean, what do you need at the 
convenience store anyway? If you're out of 
supplies, just borrow some from someone.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just to buy some convenience store 
sweets, of course♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't go! Pleaseee! If I don't eat 
now, I won't have the energy for 
tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't make a damn difference whether 
it's there or not! Besides, if you're a 
race runner yourself, don't be stuffing 
your face with that junk at this hour!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*... You're right... If it's 
come to this, then...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's our only option!!

While flipping through documents at the 
desk in my room—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Convenience store! Reward sweets! Come 
with me!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way! I want to eat it right now! Come 
with me~!
choice_data_list:
"Eating at this hour isn't good for your 
body—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Not eating right now would be far worse 
for my soul!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'll work super hard at training 
tomorrow! Pretty please? Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'll give you a shoulder massage too! 
And clean the Trainer's office!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, pretty please? Huh? Please, please, 
pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft. Hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, you've actually got some 
guts! Even though you usually give up 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright, fine! Seeing your guts, I'll 
tag along with you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Seriously!? Really!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you run properly tomorrow 
to make up for it! Otherwise, I'm never 
tagging along with you again!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll run! Yay! I love you, 
Pokke-senpai! Love you so, so much~♡♡
choice_data_list:
"Are you really going? Then I'll come 
with..."

"Are you really going? Then I'll come 
with..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No. I have a curfew, and I'll just sprint 
there to count it as training anyway.
choice_data_list: 'I see, just don't go too fast, okay?'

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No. I have a curfew, and I'll just sprint 
there to count it as training anyway.
choice_data_list: 'I see, just don't go too fast, okay?'

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then~ why don't we take a leisurely 
walk? That'd be safe, too♡

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I just told ya not to overdo it, not to 
stop running entirely. Quit whining.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Well, who cares! I'm gonna buy myself 
some treats for the round trip too~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh~~~~? Don't underestimate a genius! 
That much is easy peasy!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? You said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aargh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Let's go for a run. ...Make sure 
you keep up, got it?
